Name: Roosje Cat Replacer (for Dismal-Lead)
Author: SardonicSeriph
Description:
This is a Content Patcher mod that replaces the default cat with a custom sprite based on the dearly departed companion of Dismal-Lead on reddit. Dismal, It was an honor to make this mod for you and I hope I have done Roosje justice. She is a beautiful cat. 

[b]Installation instructions[/b]

[list]
[*]Download and install[url=https://smapi.io/] SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*]Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915?tab=files]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ 
[*]Download and unzip this mod in your mods folder or use a mod manager
[/list]

Manifest.Name: RoosjeCat
Manifest.Description: Adds reddit user Dismal-Lead's cat to the game.'
